student.title: For Students
student.lead: If you are at least 13, you can use the platform and book lessons with top tutors.

age.title: Age requirement
age.rule: To use the service as a student, you must be at least 13 years old.

profile.title: Student profile
profile.desc: After registration, complete basic info to match tutors and materials.
profile.goals: Learning goals (e.g., better grades, exam prep).

booking.title: Booking & reminders
booking.email: When you book, you’ll get an email with date, time and details.
booking.calendar: After the tutor confirms, the lesson appears in your calendar with a ready-to-join link.
booking.reschedule: You can reschedule up to 24 hours before the lesson.
booking.cancel: Late cancellations may be marked as no-show.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.afterLesson: After each lesson you can leave a rating and review.
reviews.editWindow: You have a short window to edit the review after posting.
reviews.guidelines: Be constructive and respectful — we help filter misuse.

extras.title: Extras
extras.materials: Shared lesson files and notes in one place.

tutor.title: For Tutors
tutor.lead: Build a professional profile, manage availability and confirm student bookings easily.

profile.title: Tutor profile
profile.desc: Complete your profile so students can find you.
profile.methods: Your teaching approach (e.g., problem-solving, exam prep).
profile.photo: Profile photo — welcome but not required.

availability.title: Availability
availability.slots: Define time slots and max lessons per day.

booking.title: Booking flow
booking.requests: Receive booking requests and verify details.
booking.confirmation: Upon confirmation we send an email to the student and add it to the calendar.
booking.link: Meeting link is auto-generated and visible on the lesson card.
booking.policy: 24-hour rule: changes/cancellations after that may be marked as no-show.
